name: Snell & Branham Plaza
summary: Snell & Branham Plaza is a 99,351 square foot neighborhood shopping center anchored by the area's highest-grossing Safeway, serving one of San Jose's most affluent residential communities. The center provides essential daily shopping, banking, dining, and services to a trade area with average household incomes exceeding $180,000.
demographics: Snell & Branham Plaza serves an affluent San Jose community with a 3-mile trade area population of 213,739 residents and average household income of $181,698. The center attracts primarily upper-middle-class families and professionals, with an average home value exceeding $1.1 million in the surrounding neighborhoods. The daytime population of 163,316 includes working professionals who frequent the center for convenience shopping, banking, and quick-service dining during lunch hours. With over 2.6 million annual visits, the center draws a diverse mix of local residents seeking everyday necessities from the high-performing Safeway anchor and complementary service retailers.
description: Snell & Branham Plaza is a thriving 99,351 square foot community shopping center strategically located in one of San Jose's most densely populated and affluent residential areas. Anchored by the highest-grossing Safeway in the region, this well-established center has become an essential neighborhood destination for daily shopping needs and services. The property features a carefully curated tenant mix including Panda Express for quick-service dining and Wells Fargo Bank for financial services, complemented by additional retailers serving the community's beauty care, pet supply, and fast food needs. Managed by Regency Centers, a nationally recognized shopping center developer and operator, the plaza benefits from professional management and ongoing investment in maintaining a fresh, inviting shopping environment. With convenient access from Branham Lane and serving a trade area with household incomes averaging over $180,000 and home values exceeding $1.1 million, Snell & Branham Plaza has established itself as a cornerstone retail destination in South San Jose, attracting nearly 2.7 million visits annually from loyal local shoppers.
